## Contribution

Describe the scale, correction, documentation, or tooling change. For scales, identify the make/model, coverage, source, and whether it is an original measurement, published reference, or redesign.

## Validation

Describe the checks performed and any missing measurements or unresolved questions.

## Licensing and publication

- [ ] I have authority to license my contribution under this repository's terms: CC BY 4.0 for scale data and documentation, MIT for tooling.
- [ ] I supplied source and attribution information and identified any third-party terms (or this contribution contains no third-party material).
- [ ] I reviewed the contribution for private information and its contents are intended for public distribution.
